question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.**

Gradual recovery of health and strength
solution:
The correct answer is **"Convalescence."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Convalescence"** means the process or period of resting in order to get better after an illness or operation. (स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य-लाभ)

 
 
• **Example: ***She was in a state of **convalescence**__.*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore, gradual recovery of health and strength is **"Convalescence."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Potency** means the power or strength of something. (शक्ति, प्रभाव)
 
• **Benefaction** means a charitable act or gift. (एक धर्मार्थ कार्य या उपहार)
 
• **Rejuvenation** means the process of making something look or feel younger, fresher, or more lively. (पुनर्यौवन)
